title: Conversation Export & Client Migration Playbook for conversation_v1 Sunset
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: conversation_v1 (legacy conversation endpoints) were created early in the platform to support chat stateful workflows. Over time they diverged from the unified inference API and introduce multiple client-side idiosyncrasies (streaming deltas, custom event frames, proprietary metadata keys). This ticket defines the PRD and migration playbook for retiring conversation_v1 while providing a first-class export + compatibility experience for customers who need to preserve history or migrate conversation state to the unified sessions API.

Scope: Provide an opt-in conversation export endpoint, client SDK helpers for state translation, server-side export job orchestration, migration telemetry, and a staged sunsetting timeline with rollback gates. The implementation must protect PII and comply with existing retention/KMS policies.

Out of scope: Automatic conversion of customer-baked plugins/extensions, long-term archival tooling beyond export (customers should ingest export artifacts into their own storage), and UX redesign of console conversation viewer (this will be a follow-up).
goals: 1) Enable safe, auditable export of conversation history in a structured schema that can be ingested into the unified sessions API. 2) Provide SDK helpers (JS/Python) and CLI to produce migration artifacts and test conversions locally. 3) Run migration pilots with 5-10 high-usage customers and validate zero-data-loss for canonical fields. 4) Publish clear timeline and acceptance criteria for sunset with fallbacks and SLA exceptions.
acceptance_criteria:
- Export endpoint (/v1/conversation_v1/exports) implemented with pagination, filter by date range, and schema v2 mapping.
- Export job honors KMS-encrypted attachments and audit logging is recorded to the customer's audit log stream.
- SDK migration helpers available in JS and Python with example notebooks demonstrating state mapping for at least 3 common client patterns (turn-level metadata, attachments, role-normalization).
- Automated integration tests cover export -> ingest -> replay roundtrip with matching message counts and no unauthorized field loss.
- Pilot customers (list attached) complete migration in pilot window and sign-off recorded.
- Public deprecation announcement and migration docs published 90 days before enforced routing change.
- Rollback criteria defined (error rate > 3%, migration mismatch > 1% for pilot customers, critical data loss incident).
success_metrics:
- 95% of pilot migrations succeed without manual intervention.
- <0.5% of migrated messages require support follow-up after pilot.
- 80% of active conversation_v1 usage either migrated or on a documented timeline before sunset date.
- Creation of export artifacts completes within SLA for 99th percentile jobs for 95% of requests.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot, 2026-03-15 to 2026-04-15): implement export API, SDK helpers, run 5 pilot migrations. Phase 2 (Developer Beta, 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-15): public docs, SDK GA, opt-in exports for all customers, migrate docs and sample apps. Phase 3 (Migration Window, 2026-05-16 to 2026-08-15): customers perform migrations; we provide engineering support; telemetry gates active. Phase 4 (Sunset Enforcement, 2026-08-20): conversation_v1 routed to compatibility shim for 60 days, then decommission after no active clients. Each phase includes telemetry gates, monthly stakeholder review, and rollback checkpoints.
timeline: 2026-03-10: PRD sign-off. 2026-03-15: Engineering kickoff. 2026-04-10: Pilot migrations complete. 2026-04-20: Developer beta docs live. 2026-05-15: SDK GA. 2026-05-16: Public migration window opens. 2026-08-20: Compatibility shim enabled. 2026-10-20: Final decommission planned (dependent on gate results).
tasks: Define export schema v2 and mapping doc for conversation_v1 -> sessions API
Implement export job API with job queue and pagination (ENG-ownership)
Add KMS-aware streaming for attachments and audit-log hooks
Build JS/Python SDK migration helpers and sample notebooks
Create automated roundtrip integration tests and a local migration harness
Coordinate pilot customers and schedule migration windows with CSM
Publish migration guide, CLI, and SDK release notes
Instrument telemetry events and create dashboard for migration success metrics
Write public deprecation announcement copy and support KB articles
Prepare compatibility shim and emergency rollback plan
notes: Security must sign off on KMS passthrough and audit log retention policy.
We will favor a streaming JSONL export format and an optional gzipped tarball for attachments.
Design to validate role normalization (assistant/system/user) in SDK helper to reduce customer mapping errors.
qa_checklist: Integration tests for export pagination and resume behavior
Verify KMS-encrypted attachments can be decrypted by customer's KMS policy during ingest
Validate SDK roundtrip with sample dataset (>=10k messages)
Load test export job orchestration with synthetic heavy accounts
open_questions: Do we retain ephemeral system metadata fields in exports by default or require opt-in?
Will we support field-level redaction for legal holds or is that handled by customer post-processing?
Should the compatibility shim translate only wire protocol or also synthesize legacy event frames?
